== Notes ==
* Due to its low cost, short recharge, and simple effect, this skill is a reasonable hex removal option for any Monk-secondary character.
* There is also a non-[[elite]] Monk [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal skill]] for each Monk attribute, so if you are running a build with a Monk attribute invested at a high level, you may want to use the corresponding skill instead.
